title: RSE 10/12: Lunar eclipse search (swe_lun_eclipse_when + swe_lun_eclipse_when_loc)
description:
### Summary
Port the lunar-eclipse search functions: `swe_lun_eclipse_when` (global next/previous lunar eclipse) and `swe_lun_eclipse_when_loc` (next lunar eclipse visible from `geopos`). Exposes `Ephemeris::lun_eclipse_when` and `lun_eclipse_when_loc` (`&self`).

Depends on **RSE 9** (`lun_eclipse_how` — the geometry/`dcore` the contact search brackets on) and **RSE 3** (`find_maximum`/`find_zero`).

### Files
- `src/eclipse.rs` — add `LunarEclipseGlobal` + `LunarEclipseLocal` result structs, `lun_eclipse_when`, `lun_eclipse_when_loc`.
- `src/context.rs` — `pub fn lun_eclipse_when(&self, tjd_start, ifl: CalcFlags, ifltype: EclipseFlags, backward: bool) -> Result<LunarEclipseGlobal, Error>` and `pub fn lun_eclipse_when_loc(&self, tjd_start, ifl: CalcFlags, geopos:[f64;3], backward: bool) -> Result<LunarEclipseLocal, Error>`.
- `src/lib.rs` — re-export both types.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_eclipse.c` — add keys `lun_when` + `lun_when_loc`; regenerate `eclipse.json`.
- `tests/golden/eclipse.rs` — add `#[test] lun_when` + `#[test] lun_when_loc`.

### Implementation steps
Read `docs/c-ref-eclipse-lunar.md` §4.1–§4.8 (`swe_lun_eclipse_when`), the `tret[]` table after §4.8, and §5 (`swe_lun_eclipse_when_loc`).

1. **`LunarEclipseGlobal`**: `tret[0..8]` per the §4.8 table (maximum, U1=partial begin, U4=partial end, U2=total begin, U3=total end, penumbral begin/end) + type bitmask.
2. **`lun_eclipse_when`** (§4): setup + `ifltype` normalisation (§4.1); full-moon synodic-month stepping via Meeus lunation number K (§4.2); latitude-argument F pre-filter (§4.3); approximate max time via Meeus periodic series (§4.4); precise refinement to max via `find_maximum` (§4.5); confirm/reject wrong types (§4.6); contact times via `dcore`-based `find_zero` search calling the RSE 9 geometry (§4.7). `backward` flips direction. Reuse `find_maximum`/`find_zero` from `math.rs` (§4.8) — do NOT duplicate.
3. **`LunarEclipseLocal`** + **`lun_eclipse_when_loc`** (§5): visibility scan (Moon above horizon via `swe_azalt`), moonrise/moonset clipping, the retry-jump logic. HAZARD (per doc): the three rejection sites don't all use the same live `tret[0]` — port the control flow faithfully, don't "simplify".

### C reference
`docs/c-ref-eclipse-lunar.md` §4 (all subsections), §5, §1.

### Golden tests
- **C harness** add key `lun_when`: `tjd_start ∈ {2451545.0, 2459000.5}`, `backward ∈ {0,1}`, `ifltype=0` → `swe_lun_eclipse_when(...)`. Emit `{tjd_start, backward, retval, tret:[0..8]}`. Add key `lun_when_loc`: `geopos ∈ {(8.55,47.37,500)}`, same `tjd_start`/`backward` → `swe_lun_eclipse_when_loc(...)`. Emit `{geopos, tjd_start, backward, retval, tret:[0..10], attr:[0..11]}`. Regenerate `eclipse.json`.
- **Rust tests** `#[test] lun_when` + `#[test] lun_when_loc`: assert `tret`/`attr` via `assert_f64_eps(.., 1e-5)`; assert returned flags == `retval`.
- `cargo test --test golden eclipse::lun_when -- --nocapture` and `eclipse::lun_when_loc` pass.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo build` + `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean.
- `cargo test --test golden eclipse::lun_when -- --nocapture` and `eclipse::lun_when_loc` pass (1e-5 day).

### Escape hatch
If contact times fail > 1e-4 day after two attempts, STOP and report failing `(tjd_start, backward)` + diverging slot + any type mismatch. Read `swecl.c:3378–3728` directly. Escalate to Opus after two attempts.
execution_record: Implemented as planned per docs/c-ref-eclipse-lunar.md §4/§5, cross-checked against the actual C source (swecl.c:3389-3739) for the trickiest control-flow details (contact-time dt divisors, F1's sin(Om) literal-radians quirk, the when_loc moonrise/moonset sequential-mutation hazard). Extended LunarEclipseCore (src/eclipse.rs) with dcore[0..4] fields (r0/d0/cap_d0/cosf1/cosf2) since lun_eclipse_when's contact search needs them and they weren't previously exposed. Added lun_when + lun_when_loc keys to tests/c-gen/gen_eclipse.c, regenerated eclipse.json against libswe.a. Both golden tests (eclipse::lun_when, eclipse::lun_when_loc) passed on the first implementation attempt -- no escape-hatch escalation needed. cargo build + clippy --all-targets clean; full golden suite (101 tests) green.

messages.text: Review (vidhi-review, claude inline, w/ 76): APPROVE. Faithful port of swe_lun_eclipse_when + swe_lun_eclipse_when_loc. Verified vs docs/c-ref-eclipse-lunar.md §4/§5: §4.1 ifltype normalization (strip CENTRAL/NONCENTRAL; ANNULAR/HYBRID→"don't exist" guard against infinite loop; default ALLTYPES_LUNAR); §4.4 Meeus series incl. the Om-already-in-radians *DEGTORAD quirk on F1 preserved; §4.5 dtstart 0.1/5 branch + tjd+=dtint+dt (middle-sample offset convention) + 3-pass ET→UT; §4.7 stage-A find_zero coarse bracket over ±2hr then 3-round 2-point secant refine, lun_contact_dc n=0/1/2 boundary formulas correct. §5 moonrise/moonset clipping: the three ±25-day reject sites correctly read the *live* tret[0] (geocentric-max at sites 1&2, tjd_max at site 3) — the documented HAZARD is navigated exactly; sequential tret[6]/tret[7] mutation preserved. CircumpolarBody↔C retc<0 mapping complete (riseset.rs:285). Golden: eclipse::lun_when + lun_when_loc pass @1e-5 (total/partial/penumbral + visibility-bit/moonrise-clip cases, real 17-digit C output). clippy clean. find_zero-failure divergence from C is documented + reasoned unreachable for confirmed eclipses (sound). No findings.
